expectations.statement: No pixel-day in the 2,920 files is nodata in layers 1-3.
Pooled over the four places, the share of pixel-days fully actual is at least 15% and at most 40%.
Andong's share of pixel-days fully actual is higher than at each of the other three places.
expectations.rule: 7026_3201_13 strictly higher than each other place

expectations.statement: At every place, fewer than a third of days are in class some.
expectations.rule: 3 x days in class some < the days of the series, each place

expectations.statement: Gaps are longest at Renshou: its median gap length, weighted by pixel-days, is larger than at each of the other three places.
expectations.rule: 6466_3380_13 strictly larger than each other place

expectations.statement: Among filled pixel-days, the share with no PlanetScope data (L3 = -999) is higher at Renshou than at any other place, and lower at Andong than at any other place.
For the 30-day nested window, the median covered share over a place's complete cells is at least 80% at every place.
expectations.rule: median covered share over the cells >= 80%, each place
